# Why is your Postgres query slow?

> Paste a PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan (text or JSON) and see where the time went per node, missing indexes, bad row estimates and disk spills, each with a suggested fix. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
